regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing-but-broad risk-on regime for US equities: 23 of 49 themes are trend-eligible, with the leadership structure dominated by defensive/healthcare flows branching out of a still-technically-led Memory/HBM rank. Momentum rank is a focus lens only, but the absolute-trend gate is validated on this market's history, so eligible, trend-tagged, broad themes are the only ones worth leaning on. Rotation view is 'narrowing' and 'directional: false', so I avoid handoff calls and keep leans to themes already inside the trend.

The watch retires only if SMH clears the absolute-trend gate (eligible=true) with its own durability bar rising back toward 0.6+.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the highest-ranked eligible, trend-tagged theme with full breadth (1.0) and the highest durability_bar among eligible leaders (0.85). The trend gate is validated on this market, so staying-power is concentrated here. Crowding is flagged, which is a size-down caution only, not a fade. The rotation radar shows Big Pharma as challenger behind Memory/HBM, but the handoff is NOT confirmed, so I lean overweight on the theme already inside the trend leg rather than predicting rotation.
